correctness.rationale: Bézout on both triple lines and adjunction exclude all other negative curves; complete set is 9 (-1) and 2 (-2). A selected support is negative definite exactly by pairwise disjointness plus the explicit Schur complement. Enumerating all 2048 subsets in exact rational arithmetic and independently counting line-graph configurations gives the identical bivariate polynomial. Bauer--Schmitz gives the volume criterion; root-free blow-downs have nef and big anticanonical divisor. The finite computation tests a mathematically proved exhaustive class list and is not offered as a general proof by itself.

originality.rationale: BFN and Bauer--Schmitz establish the chamber method and volume criterion, and Derenthal classifies the geometric type. None of these inspected results gives the 221/80/141/33 numerical distribution of the nine-line 2A1 quartic; the one-nodal 285- or smooth 393-chamber cases do not imply it. Remaining thesis/table risk acknowledged; originality is a best-evidence judgment, not proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: The complete bivariate negative-support enumerator is a natural deformation-sensitive invariant of a distinguished nine-line two-nodal quartic del Pezzo resolution. The 33 simultaneous-root supports encode an interaction that cannot be inferred from one-root chamber counts. The exact finite/infinite 80/141 dichotomy has geometric volume meaning, rather than being an arbitrary numeric slice.
